item.title: Meet Rosie, 5, who turned a princess scooter ride into a £4,000 fundraiser for her friend
item.description: Empowered by compassion, five-year-old Rosie is taking on a four-mile scooter challenge in a princess dress to support her friend Sid's home adaptations. Incredibly, she has raised more than four thousand pounds to help Sid obtain necessary modifications, including a through-floor lift and accessible facilities. Sid's family expresses deep gratitude for Rosie's inspiring initiative and unwavering generosity during this crucial time.

item.title: Mexico cleaned 100K+ tons of sargassum in 2026, but the seaweed crisis is now threatening its tourism
item.description: In 2026, a massive expanse of Sargassum seaweed has taken over the Atlantic Ocean, wreaking havoc on coastal areas. Mexico is facing an unprecedented surge in seaweed accumulation, which is damaging its tourism sector. The foul odor has led to a notable decline in visitors, leaving local businesses in distress. Though scientists predict improvement by late autumn, a permanent solution is still unknown.

item.title: Taiwan researchers engineer interface only 0.42 nm thick to improve next-gen MoS2 transistors
item.description: Researchers from National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University and TSMC have developed a new interface design for atomically thin transistors. They created a 0.42-nanometre aluminium oxide layer between monolayer MoS2 and a hafnium oxide dielectric. The design helped the transistors maintain strong electrical control and carrier transport while using an extremely thin insulating layer.

item.title: Why US is questioning Pakistan's Rs 3 trillion defence spending
item.description: The US State Department has flagged Pakistan's limited oversight of military and intelligence spending. Concerns were also raised regarding government debt disclosure and budget proposal publication delays. Pakistan's defence allocation has significantly increased for the upcoming financial year. The report urges greater transparency in military and intelligence budgets. This assessment highlights ongoing fiscal transparency challenges for Pakistan.

item.title: Russia kills 10 in Ukraine as Zelenskyy accuses Moscow of using N Korean missiles
item.description: Russian missile and drone attacks killed at least ten civilians across Ukraine on Tuesday. President Zelenskyy accused Moscow of using North Korean ballistic missiles in strikes. Ukraine warned Russia is exploiting its air defense interceptor shortages. Meanwhile, Ukraine struck Russian oil facilities, causing damage and casualties. The conflict continues with both sides expanding long-range strike capabilities.

North Korea fires second ballistic missile in a week ahead of US-South Korea war drills
item.description: North Korea launched a ballistic missile towards the sea on Wednesday. This marks Pyongyang's second reported missile test in less than a week. South Korea and Japan condemned the launch as a provocation. Major US-South Korea military exercises are scheduled to begin soon. North Korea continues its weapons testing program amid international concerns.

HasanAbi Seeks Perma Ban: streamer urges Twitch, YouTube to drop Asmongold; clash spotlights hate-speech rules
item.description: HasanAbi has called for Asmongold to be permanently banned from Twitch and YouTube following controversial comments that resulted in a two-week Twitch suspension. Hasan argued that Asmongold was testing the platforms’ moderation limits by refusing to apologize. He also claimed Twitch and YouTube have become more cautious about punishing controversial creators. Asmongold had not responded to Hasan’s latest remarks at the time of the report.

item.title: Mormon YouTuber Dies In Crash: podcaster killed in Utah at 27; final video dwells on afterlife
item.description: Mormon influencer Chandler David Hendry, 27, reportedly died in a three-vehicle crash in Lehi, Utah, on August 7. Police said witnesses reported that he ran a red light before striking two cars. The occupants of those vehicles were unharmed. Hendry had built a growing audience through faith-based content on YouTube, Instagram and TikTok. His final Instagram post focused on the afterlife, family sealings and eternal relationships.

item.title: Friday Debate With Andrew Wilson: Candace Owens confirms clash; Turning Point USA claims escalate feud
item.description: Candace Owens confirmed that her debate with Andrew Wilson will take place Friday, with the moderator set to be revealed on her show. She also criticized what she described as Turning Point USA’s silence following her release of uncompressed photographs. Owens questioned the organization’s alleged cooperation with journalist Brandy Zadrozny and suggested it was connected to critical coverage of her. The claims have added another layer to the ongoing controversy.

item.title: Middle East standoff: Why Gulf states may accept that Iran will control the Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Gulf energy producers have acknowledged Iran's assertion of control over the critical Strait of Hormuz. This development occurs amidst attempts to resume passage through this essential route, which are stymied by ongoing tensions. Governments in the region prioritize peace over export delays, while Iran aims for financial easing and a prohibition of international warships, extending the disruption of global energy channels.
